p.i: The words of Alma which he delivered to the people in Gideon, according to his own record.

chapter.li: LEChapter7 Verse1 Behold, my beloved brethren, seeing that I have been permitted to come unto 2PP you, therefore I attempt to address 2PP you in my language, yea, by my own mouth, seeing that it is the first time that I have spoken unto 2PP you by the words of my mouth, I having been wholly confined to the judgment seat, having had much business, that I could not come unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse2 And even I could not have come now at this time, were it not that the judgment seat hath been given to another to reign in my stead. And the Lord, in much mercy, hath granted that I should come unto 2PP you; VerseEnd Verse3 and behold, I have come, having great hopes and much desire that I should find that 2PP ye had humbled yourselves before God, and that 2PP ye had continued in the supplicating of his grace, that I should find that 2PP ye were blameless before him, that I should find that 2PP ye were not in the awful dilemma that our brethren were in at Zarahemla. VerseEnd Verse4 But blessed be the name of God, that he hath given unto me to know, yea, hath given unto me the exceeding great joy of knowing that they are established again in the way of his righteousness. VerseEnd Verse5 And I trust according to the spirit of God which is in me that I shall also have joy over 2PP you.

Nevertheless, I do not desire that my joy over 2PP you should come by the cause of so much afflictions and sorrow which I have had for the brethren at Zarahemla. For behold, my joy cometh over them after wading through much afflictions and sorrow. VerseEnd Verse6 But behold, I trust that 2PP ye are not in a state of so much unbelief as were 2PP your brethren. I trust that 2PP ye are not lifted up in the pride of 2PP your hearts. Yea, I trust that 2PP ye have not set 2PP your hearts upon riches and the vain things of the world. Yea, I trust that 2PP you do not worship idols, but that 2PP ye do worship the true and the living God, and that 2PP ye look forward for the remission of 2PP your sins, with an everlasting faith, which is to come. VerseEnd

Verse7 For behold, I say unto 2PP you, there be many things to come. And behold, there is one thing which is of more importance than they all, for behold, the time is not far distant that the Redeemer liveth and cometh among his people. VerseEnd Verse8 Behold, I do not say that he will come among us at the time of his dwelling in his mortal tabernacle; for behold, the spirit hath not said unto me that this should be the case. Now as to this thing I do not know; but this much I do know, that the Lord God hath power to do all things which are according to his word. VerseEnd Verse9 But behold, the spirit hath said this much unto me, saying, Cry unto this people, saying, Repent 2PP ye, repent 2PP ye, and prepare the way of the Lord, and walk in his paths, which are straight; for behold, the kingdom of Heaven is at hand, and the Son of God cometh upon the face of the earth. VerseEnd Verse10 And behold, he shall be born of Mary at Jerusalem, which is the land of our forefathers, she being a virgin, a precious and chosen vessel, who shall be overshadowed and conceive by the power of the holy ghost and bring forth a son, yea, even the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse11 And he shall go forth suffering pains, and afflictions, and temptations of every kind, and this that the word might be fulfilled which saith, He will take upon him the pains and the sicknesses of his people. VerseEnd Verse12 And he will take upon him death, that he may loose the bands of death which bind his people. And he will take upon him their infirmities, that his bowels may be filled with mercy according to the flesh, that he may know according to the flesh how to succor his people according to their infirmities. VerseEnd Verse13 Now the spirit knoweth all things; nevertheless, the Son of God suffereth according to the flesh, that he might take upon him the sins of his people, that he might blot out their transgressions according to the power of his deliverance. And now behold, this is the testimony which is in me. VerseEnd

Verse14 Now I say unto 2PP you that 2PP ye must repent and be born again, for the spirit saith, If 2PP ye are not born again, 2PP ye cannot inherit the kingdom of Heaven. Therefore, come and be baptized unto repentance, that 2PP ye may be washed from 2PP your sins, that 2PP ye may have faith on the Lamb of God, who taketh away the sins of the world, who is mighty to save and to cleanse from all unrighteousness. VerseEnd Verse15 Yea, I say unto 2PP you, come, and fear not, and lay aside every sin which easily doth beset 2PP you, which doth bind 2PP you down to destruction. Yea, come, and go forth, and show unto 2PP your God that 2PP ye are willing to repent of 2PP your sins, and enter into a covenant with him to keep his commandments, and witness it unto him this day by going into the waters of baptism. VerseEnd Verse16 And whosoever doeth this, and keepeth the commandments of God from thenceforth, the same will remember that I say unto him, yea, he will remember that I have said unto him, He shall have eternal life, according to the testimony of the holy spirit which testifieth in me. VerseEnd

Verse17 And now, my beloved brethren, do 2PP you believe these things? Behold, I say unto 2PP you, yea, I know that 2PP you believe them. And the way that I know that 2PP ye believe them is by the manifestation of the spirit which is in me. And now because 2PP your faith is strong concerning that, yea, concerning the things which I have spoken, great is my joy. VerseEnd Verse18 For as I said unto 2PP you from the beginning, that I had much desire that 2PP ye were not in the state of dilemma like 2PP your brethren, even so I have found that my desires have been gratified. VerseEnd Verse19 For I perceive that 2PP ye are in the paths of righteousness. I perceive that 2PP ye are in the path which leads to the kingdom of God. Yea, I perceive that 2PP ye are making his paths straight. VerseEnd Verse20 I perceive that it has been made known unto 2PP you by the testimony of his word that he cannot walk in crooked paths, neither doth he vary from that which he hath said, neither hath he a shadow of turning from the right to the left, or from that which is right to that which is wrong. Therefore, his course is one eternal round. VerseEnd Verse21 And he doth not dwell in unholy temples, neither can filthiness or anything which is unclean be received into the kingdom of God. Therefore, I say unto 2PP you, the time shall come, yea, and it shall be at the last day, that he who is filthy shall remain in his filthiness. VerseEnd

Verse22 And now, my beloved brethren, I have said these things unto 2PP you that I might awaken 2PP you to a sense of 2PP your duty to God, that 2PP ye may walk blameless before him, that 2PP ye may walk after the Holy Order of God after which 2PP ye have been received. VerseEnd Verse23 And now I would that 2PP ye should be humble, and be submissive and gentle, easy to be entreated, full of patience and long-suffering, being temperate in all things, being diligent in keeping the commandments of God at all times, asking for whatsoever things 2PP ye stand in need, both spiritual and temporal, always returning thanks unto God for whatsoever things 2PP ye do receive. VerseEnd Verse24 And see that 2PP ye have faith, hope, and charity, and then 2PP ye will always abound in good works. VerseEnd Verse25 And may the Lord bless 2PP you and keep 2PP your garments spotless, that 2PP ye may, at last, be brought to sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the holy prophets who have been ever since the world began, having 2PP your garments spotless even as their garments are spotless, in the kingdom of Heaven, to go no more out. VerseEnd

Verse26 And now, my beloved brethren, I have spoken these words unto 2PP you according to the spirit which testifieth in me. And my soul doth exceedingly rejoice because of the exceeding diligence and heed which 2PP ye have given unto my word. VerseEnd Verse27 And now, may the peace of God rest upon 2PP you, and upon 2PP your houses and lands, and upon 2PP your flocks and herds, and all that 2PP you possess, 2PP your women and 2PP your children, according to 2PP your faith and good works, from this time forth and for ever.
